description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WPF application, with MVVM binding, Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Customize individual built-in context-menu commands with ContextMenuItems: hide or disable commands, change captions and icons, and access their native items. DefaultContextMenu supports reordering and adding commands while preserving built-in handlers and selection-aware availability. ContextMenuShowing can customize, replace or suppress the next menu opening. Menu customizations survive WPF template reapplication.
title: SpiceLogic WPF HTML Editor Control
